text: 近期生物制造赛道产业与资本动作密集。多家初创企业相继完成新一轮融资，华润双鹤、鲁抗医药等上市公司持续加大布局力度，产业落地节奏显著提速。业内人士认为，生物制造行业正处于从技术创新向产业应用加速转化的关键期。在技术突破、政策支持和资本涌入的多重驱动下，行业有望在未来5—10年实现规模化发展，成为全球制造业绿色转型的重要引擎。中国凭借完备的发酵产业基础和持续的政策支持，有望在全球生物制造竞争中占据重要地位。 (中证报)
text_en: Recently, the biomanufacturing sector has seen intensive industry and capital activity. Several startups have completed new financing rounds, while listed companies such as China Resources Double Crane and Lukang Pharmaceutical continue to step up their investments, with industrial deployment accelerating notably. Industry insiders believe biomanufacturing is in a critical period of accelerating transformation from technological innovation to industrial application. Driven by technological breakthroughs, policy support, and capital inflows, the industry is expected to achieve scaled development in the next 5-10 years, becoming an important engine for green transformation of global manufacturing. Leveraging its complete fermentation industry base and sustained policy support, China is well-positioned to occupy an important place in global biomanufacturing competition. (China Securities Journal)
